name: Saint Bruno
history: A celebrated teacher at Reims who turned down a bishopric to seek God in silence. In 1084 he and six companions settled in the mountains of the Chartreuse, near Grenoble, and founded the Carthusians, monks who live as hermits in community. The order has never needed reform, it is said, because it was never deformed.
meditation: Stat crux dum volvitur orbis: the cross stands still while the world turns. Find ten minutes of silence today and let the world turn without you.
prayer: May we be aided by the intercession of St. Bruno, Your Confessor, we beseech You, O Lord; that we, who have grievously offended Your Majesty by sin, may, by his merits and prayers, obtain forgiveness for our offenses. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
